description.summary: the greet's side of the core's lock

protocol.description:
Login and screen lock are one state of orbit-core (PLANO-CORE §7): while locked, no client is drawn or gets input, except the greet. The core launches the greet itself, on a connection of its own (WAYLAND_SOCKET), and only that connection sees this global: no other client can unlock.
The greet shows itself with an ordinary xdg_toplevel; the core places it full screen on the monitor with the pointer while locked, and hides it while unlocked. The greet may stay running between locks.

interface.name: orbit_greet_v1
interface.description: Bound once by the greet. On bind the core sends the state it is in (locked or unlocked), then each change.

description.summary: the greet no longer needs the object

request.description: The core shows the session again. Ignored while unlocked.
